scene.note: Every commit gets a message a person can read: what changed, and why.

steps.note: Femi's last commit has a message that says nothing about what it did.
It is still the last commit and only on this computer, so its message can be replaced.
The same change comes back with a first line that says what it was.
Wilma asks for new postage on every order.
One line of the finds page changes, and is staged.
The commit's first line names the change in a few words.
Wilma has a reason for the new price.
Under the first line, after an empty line, the body gives that reason.
Someone reading the history next year knows why, not only what.
